item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #SLPRSD
Issued at 01:10 PM 07 October 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #CamarinesSur(SanFernando, Pasacao, Pamplona, Libmanan, Magarao, Bombon, Calabanga, Cabusao, Ocampo, Baao, Nabua, Balatan, Bato), #Albay(Libon, Oas, CityOfLigao), #OrientalMindoro(Bulalacao, Mansalay) and #Romblon(SanFernando) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #CamarinesSur(Bula, Pili, Minalabac, Milaor, NagaCity, Camaligan, Gainza and Canaman) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
